name: Hating Your Brother
overview: Scripture commands believers not to harbor hatred toward their brothers, emphasizing that such feelings must be addressed openly to prevent sin from taking root (Leviticus 19:17). Hatred is shown to provoke conflict, while love has the power to cover sins and maintain unity (Proverbs 10:12). Furthermore, Jesus teaches that loyalty to Him must surpass even the closest familial ties, illustrating that true discipleship may require a radical reordering of relational priorities, not endorsing literal hatred but a commitment that places Christ above all (Luke 14:26).
